title: Translate one access barrier into a specific participation request

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: An access request names a participation function, an actual barrier and a confirmable change. A label such as accessible does not establish that the required function works.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: New fictional talk reply: organizer confirms seated viewing and step-free entry, but questions can only be submitted through a form that closes before the talk starts. Participant needs time to understand the talk before forming a question and uses text. Organizer controls the question process and accepts clarification requests by email; no later-text alternative is confirmed.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Identify what improved, what remains blocked and one specific follow-up request. Do not treat confirmed seating as completion of the whole participation goal.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A remote event has captions but the essential diagram is described only as “over there.” What functional access issue remains?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: Viewing access is supported; contributing a question after understanding the talk remains blocked. Ask for an accepted text route during or after the talk with a usable deadline. Later fiction: organizer proposes an end-of-talk message box but has not confirmed implementation. Partial: thank for seating without checking questions. Incorrect: report full participation or infer incapacity from the form.
criteria: Each confirmed component is separated from remaining barriers

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: The diagram’s relevant content/location is missing from the nonvisual explanation. Request a usable description or accessible equivalent; captions alone do not establish access to visual information.
criteria: Each confirmed component is separated from remaining barriers
